purpose: Original-authored calibration rules. No numerical gameplay parity is asserted.
source_note: Weapon names and station permissions are manual-grounded. Manual pp20-21 supplies weapon ranges and independent MG loading; p33 supplies nominal 4-second main-gun reload, capacity 40 main rounds and 80 MG rounds. AX 5-second reload, MG cadence, main-ammo split and all damage/handling/range-target constants are provisional authored calibration.

evidence.weapon_ranges: Manual pp20-21: HEAT 2000m, sabot 2500m, AX 770-4000m, COAX 0-1000m
evidence.main_ammo_capacity: Manual p33: 40 main rounds; split16/16/8 is authored calibration
evidence.main_reload_ticks: Manual p33: nominal4seconds; AX slower per p21; AX5seconds is provisional
evidence.remaining_numeric_values: Except the evidence-tagged ranges, capacities and nominal reload: unknown original values, authored calibration only
evidence.vertical_aim_geometry: unknown original values; flat authored range, sight at 2.65m and target centers at 1.8m, vertical half-height 1.8m
